After the defense at the pass, Lie Yan heard that the Northern Vow was retreating to Qinghe and rushed to provide support.

Before departing, Gu Le gifted Lie Yan the battle armor that had accompanied him for years,
for he hoped it would protect Lie Yan and ensure his safe return.
Lie Yan accepted his elder brother's armor and headed to his battlefield.

He had, too, prepared a gift for his brother—a guqin crafted by his own hands.
But due to unfortunate circumstances, it remained at the Qinghe base and was never delivered.
If he returned triumphant, he would surely present this guqin to his brother himself.

Sadly, it was never delivered and now waits in the wilderness for someone destined to find it.
